entry.title: New: Resolution 75 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO NEGOTIATE A LEASE OF REAL PROPERTY, SITUATED AT WAIĀKEA, SOUTH HILO, COUNTY AND STATE OF HAWAIʻI, IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEYS: 2-4-057:029 AND 2-4-057:031, TO THE HAWAIʻI ISLAND VETERANS MEMORIAL, INC

Allows the Hawaiʻi Island Veterans Memorial, Inc., to continue to lease the parcels to construct and develop a veterans center and veteran housing.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 75-25 & LAAC-9 - 3/7/25
